text:
samira (People Ops): Quick sync — proposing a small pilot called 'Cheer Courier' to deliver micro-thanks (postcard + tiny swag) to folks nominated in our spot-award form. Goal: keep it low-friction, privacy-safe, and measurable. Thoughts? :mailbox_with_mail:

leo (Ops): I like the postcard idea. Low weight, cheaper shipping. We should limit to addresses opted-in and cap pilot to 60 recipients to test the flow.

victor (Rewards): Agree on cap. We can offer a choice: postcard (global) or small desk sticker pack (US/CA only). Sticker packs have a bit more fulfillment overhead but are nicer. Estimated unit cost: postcard $2, sticker pack $8.

nina (Legal): Reminder: capture explicit consent for public recognition and for collecting postal addresses. Also include a checkbox for GDPR/PECR where needed. Keep retention minimal for PII.

trevor (Eng): If you want to automate exports, Delivery-bot can accept CSV with columns: name,email,country,shipping_opt_in,address,nomination_reason. Can also call a webhook when the batch is ready.

samira (People Ops): Perfect. Action items: Leo — vendor shortlist for postcards + sticker packs; Victor — finalize item SKUs and unit cost; Trevor — webhook + sample CSV schema; Nina — consent language snippet. Pilot timeline: open nominations next Mon, compile list by the 25th, ship first batch end-of-month.

delivery-bot: reminder scheduled: "Run export for Cheer Courier pilot" on 2222222280. :robot_face:

leo (Ops): I'll ping two vendors (PostnShip, LocalDrops) and get lead times. If we stick to postcards only for global and sticker packs for US/CA/UK, customs should be minimal.

victor (Rewards): I'll prepare a short tracking sheet so we can record redemption type, shipped date, and whether recipient opted for public shoutout. Keeping the analytics tight will help ROI.

samira (People Ops): Thanks all — will draft the nomination form language (consent + shipping opt-in) and a short announcement. We'll reconvene after the pilot to decide scale. :confetti_ball:
